lines.speaker: veronica
lines.text: Thanks for calling City Centre Dentistry, Dr. Mand's office — this is the front desk. How can I help you today?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hi there — I've been thinking about getting Botox, and maybe Invisalign down the line. I just wanted to find out what that costs?

lines.speaker: veronica
lines.text: Absolutely — those are two of the things Dr. Mand does a lot of here at City Centre, so you've called the right place. Pricing really depends on your specific situation, so rather than give you a number that might be off, what we do is a free consultation — Dr. Mand takes a look, talks you through your options for both the Botox and the Invisalign, and gives you an exact estimate right there. No cost, no obligation. Would you like me to book that for you?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Oh nice, it's free? Yeah, let's do that.

lines.speaker: veronica
lines.text: Great choice. Have you seen Dr. Mand before, or would this be your first time at City Centre?

lines.speaker: veronica
lines.text: Welcome — I'll get you set up as a new patient so everything's ready when you arrive. Can I start with your first and last name?

lines.speaker: veronica
lines.text: Thanks, Jordan. And the best number to reach you at, in case we need to confirm anything before your visit?

lines.speaker: veronica
lines.text: Perfect. Dr. Mand has a free consultation opening this Thursday at 2:30, or Friday morning at 10 — would either of those suit you?

lines.speaker: veronica
lines.text: You're all set, Jordan — Thursday at 2:30 with Dr. Mand for a free consult on the Botox and Invisalign, and I've got you in as a new patient. We'll send a text reminder the day before. Anything else I can help you with?

lines.speaker: veronica
lines.text: My pleasure, Jordan — we're looking forward to seeing you Thursday. Take care now!
